nodes.name: CON or Drive Auto speed rolls adjust MOV for the chase and determine participation
Cut to the chase establishes the opening range and location chain
Chase rounds act in DEX order; tied DEX uses an opposed DEX roll
Each participant has one action plus one per MOV above the slowest participant
Pushed rolls are not used during an active chase
Hazards allow cautious bonus dice; failure still advances and costs damage plus 1D3 movement actions
Barriers block progress until negotiated or broken and carry explicit hit points
Same-location conflict uses combat or opposed vehicle control within chase action economy
The lead quarry may choose alternate routes
Players and Keeper alternate Luck calls for sudden Regular hazards
Pedal to the Metal trades one action for 2-5 locations with penalty dice
Passengers act once; moving fire takes a penalty die while stopped fire costs one movement action
Joining participants and changed movement modes recalculate speed/action state as specified
Multiple-character chases eliminate outpaced participants and position each side by MOV
Vehicle MOV, Build, armor, passengers, impairment, and collision severity come from Tables V and VI
A quarry may escape by breaking contact or hiding when the pursuer cannot relocate it
